description: A sleek contemporary residential exterior at night, centered on an infinity-edge or rectangular swimming pool with still blue water reflecting the warm glow from the pool surround. The pool coping and surrounding terrace are broad slabs of light-toned concrete or limestone pavers. A manicured grass lawn runs along the left edge of the terrace. Three low-profile pathway or terrace objects recede in perspective from the foreground to the middle distance along the pool edge, each emitting a warm amber downward glow that pools on the pale concrete paving beneath them — creating a rhythmic succession of warm golden halos along the pool edge. In the background, a flat-roofed modern single-story residence with white or light stone cladding features floor-to-ceiling black-framed glass walls across the full width — the interior is warmly illuminated in amber tones, showing a living room with a cream sofa, a dining arrangement, and a table beyond. Trees and dark garden landscape press in from both sides. The overall mood is serene and luxurious — cool blue water, dark sky, warm amber light on pale stone. Camera is at low eye-level, wide to normal lens, one-point perspective looking from the foreground corner of the pool toward the house along the pool edge. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
